Claire / team —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposal for the POC success checklist and immediate next steps so we can land scope and owners. I captured the metrics you asked us to prioritize plus a few Redwood recommendations.

Proposed POC window: 2026-07-26 -> 2026-08-23 (4 weeks)
Key milestones:
- Week 0 (07/26): smoke tests + data ingestion verification
- Week 1: baseline latency/throughput measurements with sample workload
- Week 2: quality evaluation on your labeled set + hallucination checks
- Week 3: cost/perf optimization pass and handoff readout

Success criteria (proposed) — we can iterate:
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms (tail within 250ms) on 6k token windows
- Throughput: sustained 50 requests/sec (avg) with bursts to 120 req/sec for short periods
- Cost: effective cost/token <= $0.0004 for the evaluated config
- Quality: 92%+ pass rate on your acceptance testset (we'll agree on sampling), hallucination incidence < 1.5%
- Availability: no more than 1 outage >5m during the POC window

Measurement plan (high level):
- Run replay of anonymized recent traffic (you provide sample) + a synthetic spike test
- Collect token-level cost, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rates, and p95/p99 latencies
- Quality: Redwood will run the supplied testset (see sample-testset.csv) and produce a confusion / error breakdown

Owners (suggested):
- Sales lead / single-threaded owner: Maya Srinivasan (Redwood)
- Infra / performance lead: Karthik Iyer (Redwood)
- Customer success & onboarding: Ben Carter (Redwood)
- Customer technical lead: Claire Boyd (Acme)
- Procurement / commercial: Tom Hayes (Acme)

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm the POC start date (we've penciled 07/26)
2) Share a representative sample dataset (anonymized) and expected concurrency profile
3) Confirm whether you require a VPC/private deployment for the POC or if hosted with IP/TLS protection is acceptable for evaluation
4) Please share the procurement contact details (Tom copied) and any contract gating items you anticipate

Attachments: acme-poc-success-metrics.xlsx (proposed success metric table), sample-testset.csv (small sample)

I'll follow up with a short technical runbook from Karthik and a billing estimate from Ben.
